components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for add and confirm flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.01em; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 90%, black 10%); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Toolbar and settings affordance with low visual weight.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost svg { width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Irreversible action button for clear and remove flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--destructive); color: var(--destructive-foreground); font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 90%, black 10%); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 45%, transparent); }

components.name: List Input Field
components.description: Primary list entry field with clear focus and disabled states.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Add item or say a command..." />
components.css: .ds-input { width: min(100%, 34rem); height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.005em; line-height: 1.4; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--card) 60%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-card { width: min(100%, 38rem); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--border) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--card) 92%, transparent); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); overflow: clip; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--border) 60%, transparent); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-card-count { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.1rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--secondary) 100%, transparent); color: var(--secondary-foreground); } .ds-card-body { padding: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Smart Confidence Badge
components.html: Smart

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Compact system-state helper labels for icon-only status indicators.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; max-width: 16rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.22); animation: ds-tooltip-in 180ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } @keyframes ds-tooltip-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px) scale(0.95); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } }

components.name: Dropdown Action Item
components.description: Menu-row pattern used for recipe, scan, and bulk-add actions.
components.css: .ds-menu-surface { width: 14rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.25rem; background: var(--popover); color: var(--popover-foreground); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14); } .ds-menu-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: transparent; color: inherit; padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem; text-align: left; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.3; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-item svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); outline: none; }

components.name: Progress Track
components.description: Compact completion progress used in the shopping header.
components.css: .ds-progress { position: relative; width: min(100%, 22rem); height: 0.5rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 20%, transparent); } .ds-progress-indicator { height: 100%; width: 100%; flex: 1 1 auto; background: var(--primary); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }

components.name: Dialog Overlay
components.description: Modal overlay and panel for focused confirmation or edit tasks.
components.html:
Edit Item

components.css: .ds-dialog-overlay { position: relative; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; width: min(100%, 30rem); min-height: 18rem; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); border-radius: 0.5rem; } .ds-dialog { position: relative; width: min(100%, calc(100% - 2rem)); max-height: calc(100dvh - 2rem); overflow-y: auto; display: grid; gap: 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18); animation: ds-dialog-in 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); padding: 1rem; } .ds-dialog-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-dialog-head h3 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dialog-close { position: absolute; top: 1rem; right: 1rem; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 2px; opacity: 0.7; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-dialog-close svg { width: 0.9rem; height: 0.9rem; } .ds-dialog-close:hover { opacity: 1; background: var(--accent); } .ds-dialog-close:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring); } .ds-dialog-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--muted-foreground); } @keyframes ds-dialog-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }

narrative.overview:
This interface is designed as a calm operational layer for real grocery trips, not as entertainment and not as analytics theater. The system prioritizes immediate readability, one-handed interaction, and confidence cues that make machine learning feel useful instead of mysterious.

Visual density stays practical: clear top-level hierarchy, compact but touch-safe controls, and fast state feedback for list progression. Intelligence appears as gentle reinforcement (confidence badges, smart suggestions, route-aware grouping) while the main task of adding and checking off items always stays dominant.

The system explicitly rejects PRODUCT.md anti-references by design: playful gamified shopping app language, ad-heavy coupon-app aesthetics, and enterprise dashboard visual language are prohibited.
keyCharacteristics: High legibility in varied store lighting and distracted use contexts.
Restrained color strategy with one primary action hue and one signal accent.
State-driven motion and micro-feedback, never decorative choreography.
Familiar control vocabulary (input, button, card, badge, dialog) with consistent shape and focus treatment.
Mobile-first spacing and sticky interaction zones for in-motion use.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Primary and accent colors are reserved for action, state, and guidance. Decorative flooding is prohibited.

rules.name: The Scan-First Rule
rules.body: Body and action text must remain legible at glance distance on mobile; ornamental display behavior is forbidden.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat at rest. Lift is reserved for interaction state or modal context.

rules.name: The Complete State Matrix Rule
rules.body: Buttons, inputs, badges, cards, and overlays must always define default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, and error behavior before shipping.

dos: Do keep action color assignment strict: green for primary progression, citrus for signal-level emphasis.
Do preserve the compact control rhythm (2.25rem to 3.5rem control heights) for one-handed scanning and tapping.
Do use explicit interaction states across every control: default, hover, focus, active, disabled, and error.
Do surface route-learning intelligence as supportive context, never as the main visual payload.
Do maintain strong text contrast on tinted surfaces and status badges.
Do keep destructive actions visually distinct from progression actions at every breakpoint.
donts: Don't introduce a playful gamified shopping app tone in visuals, copy cadence, or motion behavior.
Don't adopt ad-heavy coupon-app aesthetics (attention-fragmenting banners, aggressive promotional color bursts, noisy CTA stacks).
Don't drift into enterprise dashboard visual language (dense metric tiles, analytic-heavy framing, command-center styling).
Don't use decorative motion that does not communicate state or workflow progression.
Don't apply heavy color or full-saturation accents to inactive states.
Don't use primary progression green for warning, destructive, or neutral inactive states.
